docs.title: 4xx: Client Error
docs.text: Status Code Body Usecase 400 Bad Request { "message": "Invalid request" } Server cannot process the request due to client error 401 Unauthorized { "message": "Authentication required" } Requires user authentication 403 Forbidden { "message": "Access denied" } Understood the request, but refuses to authorize it. 404 Not Found { "message": "Resource not found" } Server can't find the requested resource 405 Method Not Allowed { "message": "Method not allwoed" } Request is not allowed for the resource
